content.text: {"findings":[{"title":"Add Sentry, SigNoz and Dynatrace to the supported-tools list, each with its own MCP server","effect":["new capability"],"proof":"adoption only","effort":"Hours","where":[{"file":"README.md","line":91,"text":"| Datadog | Query metrics, monitors, dashboards, and traces |"}],"why":"The README's integrations table is how SRE teams check whether their tools work with AURA, and it has no row for Sentry, SigNoz or Dynatrace. Each vendor publishes its own MCP server, and AURA's MCP manager can already connect over streamable HTTP, SSE or STDIO. Adoption means one example TOML config per server and one README row each. Sentry's server is listed as remote, SigNoz ships as a container image and the Dynatrace Managed server as an npm package, which fits the STDIO transport.","options":[{"name":"Sentry","what":"Sentry's own server for error monitoring, issue tracking and debugging; it is listed as remote, so it can be reached over HTTP.","needs":"A config example under examples/ and a README row.","source":"https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-mcp"},{"name":"SigNoz","what":"SigNoz's own server for metrics, traces, logs, alerts and dashboards; SigNoz can be self-hosted.","needs":"Run the signoz/signoz-mcp-server container, a config example and a README row.","source":"https://github.com/SigNoz/signoz-mcp-server"},{"name":"Dynatrace Managed","what":"Dynatrace's own server for logs, events and metrics from Dynatrace Managed, which teams run themselves.","needs":"Run the npm package @dynatrace-oss/dynatrace-managed-mcp-server over STDIO, a config example and a README row.","source":"https://github.com/dynatrace-oss/dynatrace-managed-mcp"}],"sources":["https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-mcp","https://github.com/SigNoz/signoz-mcp-server","https://github.com/dynatrace-oss/dynatrace-managed-mcp"],"lever":"","deadline":""}],"floor_verdicts":[],"watching":[],"held_back":[{"thing":"Netdata MCP server","date":"23 Oct 2026","reason":"Netdata is a real vendor, but it's less widely recognised among SRE teams than the three chosen, so it was left out.","source":"https://github.com/netdata/netdata"},{"thing":"Kubernetes MCP servers (mcp-k8s-ro, kubernetes-mcp-server)","date":"30 Oct 2026","reason":"Kubernetes is already in the README's integrations list.","source":"https://github.com/your-ko/mcp-k8s-ro"}]}
